rows.result: Chronicle your adventures — What do you describe within logs, journals, or maps? What adventure still calls to you?
Commune with nature — What flora or fauna do you encounter? What inspiration do you draw from the experience?
Concoct a plan — What new strategy do you devise? How will you put this plan in motion?
Conduct research — What is the nature of the research? What information or insight do you gain?
Conduct training — What skills or knowledge do you share? Who accepts the guidance, and who resists it?
Confess a secret — What do you reveal of your nature or background? How do others respond?
Conjure up the past — What is the subject of this reminiscence? Why is it meaningful in this moment?
Create an object or artwork — What do you create? What is it intended for?
Experience a dream or vision — What is the nature of the dream or vision? What meaning do you draw from it?
Fight in a sparring match — Who do you spar with? What issues do you provoke or resolve during the match?
Find peace — How do you reflect, meditate, or pray? What enlightenment do you gain?
Hear a confession — Who shares an aspect of their nature or background? What do they reveal?
Indulge a vice — What weakness or need do you indulge? How is this viewed by others?
Join an event — What is the occasion of this social gathering? How do you participate?
Lead or join a song — What is the subject of this song? Why is it meaningful to you or others?
Motivate others — Why is this motivation needed, and what is your approach? How do they respond?
Play a game — Who do you play with? What is discussed during the game?
Practice a skill — What talent do you hone? What do you learn from the exercise?
Ready your gear — How do you maintain your equipment or gear up? What are you preparing for?
Record a message — Who is the message meant for? What news or feelings do you share?
Reinvent your look — What inspires you to remake yourself? How do you debut your new look?
Settle a conflict — What caused this argument or fight? How do you resolve the situation?
Share intimacy — Who do you spend time with? How does your relationship evolve?
Share your heritage — What do you offer of your family's or people's history? What memory or regret does it evoke?
Stay vigilant — What are you on the lookout for? What do you spot or overhear?
Stir up trouble — What conflict do you incite or inflame? Why is the situation left unresolved?
Take in the view — What sublime or dramatic scenery do you witness? What emotion or memory does it inspire?
Tell a tale — What is the nature of this myth or legend? What emotion or lesson lingers after the telling?
Undertake a communal labor — What demanding project do you embark on with others? How does this bring you closer together?
Undertake a menial task — What solitary chore do you perform? What do you daydream about as you work?
